author: Hotochin
text:
Mr Fish wrote: Some more homework and more to come, stating to see more things on the charts - I need a bigger screen:)

Hey Mr. Fish.

I have a comment on your ignored supply that you have marked. I was chatting with FX Sniffer some time ago and addressed this point with him. I am not sure if that would really be considered ignored as it did react. To make sure I am clear I pointed to what I think you marked as ignored supply with a yellow arrow. I think the reaction was the area that the red arrow is pointing to. From what I gathered from FX was that my area marked with a purple box would be ignored as price shot straight through it. This is just my two cents. I thought it might help you.

author: Mr Fish
text: Thanks Hotochin, I see what you are saying and yes, it does look as though it had a reaction of sorts.

author: Mrgerry
text:
A query.

Could I call these areas that I marked as "ignored supply"? and If it's correct to mark in this way...

author: Hotochin
text:
Hey Mrgerry,

Based on my conversation with FX Sniffer the answer is yes. To be ignored you don't want any reaction at all. Your yellow arrows are ignored areas when price blows right through them.
